# Miya Gold-Lane Reset Windows

Miya spikes when one clean lane reset becomes the trigger for the next objective cycle.

## What to watch

- Crash the wave only when river control can be claimed immediately.
- Use the reset to return on tempo, not to chase extra lane damage.
- Protect the second firing angle after peel tools are traded.

## Why it matters

Her value rises the moment a reset changes map ownership instead of just lane comfort.

> Treat the first clean reset as a macro trigger, not a shopping trip.

More on Miya: keep this read connected to marksman gold structures, not just isolated mechanics.
